title: Refuge from Satan during prayer or recitation
arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ، وَاتْفُلْ عَلَى يَسَارِكَ (ثلاثاً)
transliteration: A'ūdhu billāhi minash-shayṭānir-rajīm. (Say:) I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast (then blow with a little spittle to your left). (Do this three times reciting in Arabic.)
translation: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast. (Then blow with a little spittle to your left. Do this three times.)
